decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. Instant transfers to other banks are free for the next 4 weeks. For 4 weeks your Cobalt debit card earns 2%, up to $10 cash back. We have added 150 support staff for the coming weeks.
decisions.why:
Chosen by the optimizer for week 3 (everyone).
Actions: Free instant transfers to other banks, Debit card cash back for 4 weeks, Extra support staff for 4 weeks.
Cost $3,100,000 of the $4M budget.

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. Instant transfers to other banks are free for the next 2 weeks. If you need it, you can get a zero-interest advance of up to $500, repaid from your next deposit. You can order a free new card at any time, and we now send an alert for every card payment.
